stories.title: Sacramento Mayor Kevin McCarty fined $29,500 for campaign expense violations, says FPPC
stories.summary: Sacramento Mayor Kevin McCarty says he paid a $29,500 fine for violating campaign finance laws, including using funds for personal expenses, according to the FPPC.

stories.title: Around 40 animals die in fire at Stanislaus Wildlife Care Center
stories.summary: The Hughson Fire Department is investigating a fire that killed about 40 animals at the Stanislaus Wildlife Care Center.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Early morning showers but otherwise clearing Friday. Some light showers expected this weekend.

stories.title: Northern California ski resorts: Opening dates, locations, info on passes
stories.summary: As Northern California welcomes one of its first seasonal storms, ski enthusiasts can rejoice as increased snowfall prompts several resort openings.

stories.title: Judge bars California from enforcing certain laws against federal law enforcement
stories.summary: A federal judge has blocked California from enforcing four state laws regulating federal law enforcement officers and agencies.

stories.title: New SMF garage more than doubles parking capacity ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: One of the new garage's biggest features is designed to help drivers spend less time searching for an available space.

stories.title: California attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over concerns about China and investor disclosures
stories.summary: California AG Rob Bonta subpoenaed Nvidia over concerns that advanced chips or confidential information may have reached China and investors may have been misled.

stories.title: Early flu season brings two deaths in Placer County
stories.summary: Placer County reports two flu-related deaths as hospitalizations surpass last season's peak about seven weeks earlier than last year.

stories.title: New court filing details alleged dismemberment and disposal of remains in Placer County cold case
stories.summary: A new court filing details allegations that two women dismembered a Citrus Heights man's body, concealed his death and collected his benefits for years.

stories.title: Two men accused of moving meth from Southern California to Portland
stories.summary: Two men have been indicted on federal charges in an alleged methamphetamine trafficking operation involving shipments from Southern California to Portland.

stories.title: California wildfire survivors push for full restitution under new law
stories.summary: AB 2700 requires state regulators to determine how victims of utility-caused wildfires can be fully compensated. But it could be a while

stories.title: Risk of tornadoes for the valley as a major storm rolls through Northern California
stories.summary: The biggest storm of the season so far will bring a risk of severe weather and slight risk of tornadoes Thursday in Northern California.
